author: agent:hub-worker
rationale: Recorded as it happened: the first run of the per-feature checks moved out of CI found a real build failure.

ops.title: crypt alone didn't build under clippy: imports only the sqlite codec uses
ops.body: `cargo clippy --no-default-features --features crypt --all-targets -- -D warnings` failed on two unused imports in src/log/crypt.rs (serde::Serialize, serde::de::DeserializeOwned), which only the sqlite-gated Encrypted codec uses. CI never caught it: it ran clippy under all, default and no default features, never a feature alone. Fixed by gating both imports with #[cfg(feature = "sqlite")]. Lesson: a feature's code is checked with that feature alone, so imports and helpers that serve another feature carry that feature's cfg; the per-feature clippy checks are now declared as release gates.
